Simplified comparison. Rent and operating costs stay constant; cash flow is not reinvested. Excludes taxes, leasing fees, and unforeseen capital expenses. Assumptions are not predicted outcomes.

Understand the assumptions.

Sell: (current value × (1 − selling cost %) − loan balance) grows at the reinvestment assumption for the chosen years. Hold: projected sale proceeds after modeled costs and reduced loan balance + cumulative cash flow − preparation costs. Annual principal reduction is capped at the loan balance. Debt payments include the entered principal reduction; do not subtract it twice.
